legend: The anterior border of the iris shows a nodule composed of bland spindle-shaped melanocytes within the superficial iris stroma.
source: (Professor Ralph Eagle, Department of Pathology, Wills Eye Hospital, Sidney Kimmel Medical College of Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, PA, USA)

legend: Immunohistochemistry shows S100 positivity of the melanocytic cells.
source: (Professor Ralph Eagle, Department of Pathology, Wills Eye Hospital, Sidney Kimmel Medical College of Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, PA, USA)

legend: Slit-lamp photograph of iris shows multiple small, variably sized, tan-coloured elevations.
